Package com.j3d.threads

Class StatisticsThread

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.SwingWorker<Void,Map<UUID,Integer>>
com.j3d.threads.StatisticsThread
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, Future<Void>, RunnableFuture<Void>
public class StatisticsThread extends SwingWorker<Void,Map<UUID,Integer>>
A background thread that collects and reports statistics to the Swing Event Dispatch Thread (EDT) once per second.

This class uses a SwingWorker to perform a long-running task (collecting stats) on a background thread, preventing the UI from freezing. It safely publishes the collected data to the EDT for UI updates.

The statistics are stored as thread-safe AtomicIntegers, allowing any outside class to increment them at any time without causing concurrency issues.

    • doInBackground

      protected Void doInBackground() throws Exception
      The main background task. This method runs on a worker thread, not the EDT.

      It enters a loop that, once per second, captures the current value of all statistic counters, resets them to zero, and then publishes the captured values to the process(java.util.List<java.util.Map<java.util.UUID, java.lang.Integer>>) method.

      Specified by:
      doInBackground in class SwingWorker<Void,Map<UUID,Integer>>
      Returns:
      null, as this worker does not return a final result.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted while sleeping.
      Exception

    • process

      protected void process(List<Map<UUID,Integer>> chunks)
      Receives data chunks from the publish method and executes on the EDT.

      This method is guaranteed to run on the Event Dispatch Thread, making it safe to update Swing components. It calls the UI updater with the latest statistics.

      Overrides:
      process in class SwingWorker<Void,Map<UUID,Integer>>
      Parameters:
      chunks - A list of statistics maps published from the background thread. In this implementation, it will typically contain one map per second.
